description: SentLines turns each sentence into corrected, aligned translations for language practice.

interface.longDescription: Choose the language you want to study, set an A1–C2 practice level, add the languages you already know, and begin with an automatic level-matched paragraph demo. SentLines corrects each sentence in your practice language and displays aligned translations line by line. Type naturally, share an image with text, or write a phrase approximately as you heard it. B1 is the default until you explicitly change it.

name: sentlines
